_meta.description: Curated biblical family-tree data covering the canonical Adam → Jesus line per Matthew 1 + Luke 3. Years are: AM (Anno Mundi, since Creation) for Genesis 5 + 11 figures where the Bible gives explicit ages; BC for figures from Abraham onward where standard scholarly chronology applies. Verse refs use canonical English book names and parse cleanly via lib/utils/reference_parser.dart.

yearLegend.am: Anno Mundi (years since Creation, derived from Genesis 5 and 11)
yearLegend.bc: Years before Christ (standard chronology; Ussher baseline for patriarchs, Thiele for kings)

people.name: Adam
people.summary: First man, created from the dust of the earth and placed in Eden.
people.summaryZhHans: 首位人类,被神用尘土所造,安置在伊甸园中。
people.summaryZhHant: 首位人類,被神用塵土所造,安置在伊甸園中。

people.name: Eve
people.summary: The mother of all the living; formed by God from Adam's side.
people.summaryZhHans: 众生之母;神从亚当身上取出造成的女人。
people.summaryZhHant: 眾生之母;神從亞當身上取出造成的女人。

people.name: Cain
people.summary: Adam and Eve's firstborn; first murderer, killed his brother Abel out of envy.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚当与夏娃的长子;首位凶手,因嫉妒杀害弟弟亚伯。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞當與夏娃的長子;首位兇手,因嫉妒殺害弟弟亞伯。

people.name: Abel
people.summary: Adam and Eve's second son; offered an acceptable sacrifice and was killed by Cain.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚当与夏娃的次子;献上蒙悦纳之祭,被该隐所杀。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞當與夏娃的次子;獻上蒙悅納之祭,被該隱所殺。

people.name: Seth
people.summary: Born when Adam was 130; the appointed seed through whom the godly line continued.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚当一百三十岁时所生;承接敬虔后裔的应许之子。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞當一百三十歲時所生;承接敬虔後裔的應許之子。

people.name: Enosh
people.summary: Seth's son; in his days people began to call upon the name of the LORD.
people.summaryZhHans: 塞特之子;那时人开始呼求耶和华的名。
people.summaryZhHant: 塞特之子;那時人開始呼求耶和華的名。

people.name: Kenan
people.summary: Born when Enosh was 90; lived 910 years.
people.summaryZhHans: 以挪士九十岁时所生;享寿九百一十岁。
people.summaryZhHant: 以挪士九十歲時所生;享壽九百一十歲。

people.name: Mahalalel
people.summary: Born when Kenan was 70; lived 895 years.
people.summaryZhHans: 该南七十岁时所生;享寿八百九十五岁。
people.summaryZhHant: 該南七十歲時所生;享壽八百九十五歲。

people.name: Jared
people.summary: Father of Enoch the prophet; lived 962 years.
people.summaryZhHans: 先知以诺之父;享寿九百六十二岁。
people.summaryZhHant: 先知以諾之父;享壽九百六十二歲。

people.name: Enoch
people.summary: Walked with God; was taken by God without seeing death. Prophet who foretold the Lord's coming.
people.summaryZhHans: 与神同行;被神接去未尝死味。预言主再来的先知。
people.summaryZhHant: 與神同行;被神接去未嘗死味。預言主再來的先知。

people.name: Methuselah
people.summary: Longest-lived person in Scripture (969 years); died the year of the Flood.
people.summaryZhHans: 圣经中寿数最长之人(九百六十九岁);洪水之年去世。
people.summaryZhHant: 聖經中壽數最長之人(九百六十九歲);洪水之年去世。

people.name: Lamech
people.summary: Father of Noah; named him 'Noah' (rest), prophesying comfort from the cursed ground.
people.summaryZhHans: 挪亚之父;为他取名挪亚(安息),预言从受咒诅之地得安慰。
people.summaryZhHant: 挪亞之父;為他取名挪亞(安息),預言從受咒詛之地得安慰。

people.name: Noah
people.summary: Righteous man preserved through the Flood; built the ark; covenant of the rainbow.
people.summaryZhHans: 义人,藉方舟在洪水中得保全;立彩虹之约。
people.summaryZhHant: 義人,藉方舟在洪水中得保全;立彩虹之約。

people.name: Shem
people.summary: Eldest son of Noah; ancestor of the Semitic peoples and of the Messianic line.
people.summaryZhHans: 挪亚的长子;闪族的祖先,弥赛亚血脉所自出。
people.summaryZhHant: 挪亞的長子;閃族的祖先,彌賽亞血脈所自出。

people.name: Ham
people.summary: Second son of Noah; ancestor of the African and Canaanite peoples; cursed through Canaan.
people.summaryZhHans: 挪亚的次子;非洲与迦南诸族的祖先;咒诅由迦南承受。
people.summaryZhHant: 挪亞的次子;非洲與迦南諸族的祖先;咒詛由迦南承受。

people.name: Japheth
people.summary: Third son of Noah; ancestor of the Indo-European peoples per the Table of Nations.
people.summaryZhHans: 挪亚的第三子;印欧诸族的祖先(列国志)。
people.summaryZhHant: 挪亞的第三子;印歐諸族的祖先(列國志)。

people.name: Arphaxad
people.summary: Born two years after the Flood; first of the post-Flood patriarchs in the Messianic line.
people.summaryZhHans: 生于洪水后两年;洪水后弥赛亚血脉中的首位先祖。
people.summaryZhHant: 生於洪水後兩年;洪水後彌賽亞血脈中的首位先祖。

people.name: Shelah
people.summary: Born when Arphaxad was 35; father of Eber.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚法撒三十五岁时所生;希伯之父。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞法撒三十五歲時所生;希伯之父。

people.name: Eber
people.summary: Eponymous ancestor of the Hebrews; lived 464 years.
people.summaryZhHans: 希伯来人之祖,族名所由出;享寿四百六十四岁。
people.summaryZhHant: 希伯來人之祖,族名所由出;享壽四百六十四歲。

people.name: Peleg
people.summary: His name means 'division' — in his days the earth was divided (Babel).
people.summaryZhHans: 其名意为'分散'——他的日子,地被分裂(巴别塔)。
people.summaryZhHant: 其名意為「分散」——他的日子,地被分裂(巴別塔)。

people.name: Reu
people.summary: Patriarch in the line from Shem to Abraham.
people.summaryZhHans: 由闪到亚伯拉罕谱系中的列祖。
people.summaryZhHant: 由閃到亞伯拉罕譜系中的列祖。

people.name: Serug
people.summary: Patriarch in the line from Shem to Abraham.
people.summaryZhHans: 由闪到亚伯拉罕谱系中的列祖。
people.summaryZhHant: 由閃到亞伯拉罕譜系中的列祖。

people.name: Nahor (the elder)
people.summary: Father of Terah; grandfather of Abraham. (Distinct from Abraham's brother Nahor.)
people.summaryZhHans: 他拉之父;亚伯拉罕的祖父。(与亚伯拉罕之兄弟拿鹤同名,异人。)
people.summaryZhHant: 他拉之父;亞伯拉罕的祖父。(與亞伯拉罕之兄弟拿鶴同名,異人。)

people.name: Terah
people.summary: Father of Abraham; led the family from Ur of the Chaldees toward Canaan; settled in Haran.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚伯拉罕之父;率家由迦勒底的吾珥往迦南,定居于哈兰。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞伯拉罕之父;率家由迦勒底的吾珥往迦南,定居於哈蘭。

people.name: Abraham
people.summary: Father of the faithful; called from Ur, given the covenant of land, seed, and blessing for all nations through his offspring.
people.summaryZhHans: 信心之父;蒙召离开吾珥,领受地业、子孙与万族蒙福之约。
people.summaryZhHant: 信心之父;蒙召離開吾珥,領受地業、子孫與萬族蒙福之約。

people.name: Sarah
people.summary: Wife of Abraham; bore Isaac in her old age — a child of promise.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚伯拉罕之妻;高龄生以撒——应许之子。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞伯拉罕之妻;高齡生以撒——應許之子。

people.name: Hagar
people.summary: Egyptian maidservant of Sarah; mother of Ishmael; saw God in the wilderness ('El-Roi').
people.summaryZhHans: 撒拉的埃及使女;以实玛利之母;在旷野见神,称之为'看顾人的神'。
people.summaryZhHant: 撒拉的埃及使女;以實瑪利之母;在曠野見神,稱之為「看顧人的神」。

people.name: Keturah
people.summary: Abraham's wife after Sarah's death; mother of six sons including Midian.
people.summaryZhHans: 撒拉死后亚伯拉罕之妻;生六子,其中包括米甸。
people.summaryZhHant: 撒拉死後亞伯拉罕之妻;生六子,其中包括米甸。

people.name: Ishmael
people.summary: Abraham's elder son by Hagar; ancestor of twelve tribes; promise of becoming a great nation.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚伯拉罕由夏甲所生之长子;十二族之祖;蒙应许成为大国。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞伯拉罕由夏甲所生之長子;十二族之祖;蒙應許成為大國。

people.name: Isaac
people.summary: Child of promise; offered up by Abraham on Mount Moriah; received the covenant blessing.
people.summaryZhHans: 应许之子;父亚伯拉罕在摩利亚山献上;承受立约之福。
people.summaryZhHant: 應許之子;父亞伯拉罕在摩利亞山獻上;承受立約之福。

people.name: Rebekah
people.summary: Isaac's wife; mother of Esau and Jacob; received the oracle that the elder would serve the younger.
people.summaryZhHans: 以撒之妻;以扫与雅各之母;蒙启示——大的将服事小的。
people.summaryZhHant: 以撒之妻;以掃與雅各之母;蒙啟示——大的將服事小的。

people.name: Esau
people.summary: Isaac's elder son; sold his birthright for a pottage of lentils; ancestor of Edom.
people.summaryZhHans: 以撒的长子;为一碗红豆汤卖了长子的名分;以东族之祖。
people.summaryZhHant: 以撒的長子;為一碗紅豆湯賣了長子的名分;以東族之祖。

people.name: Jacob (Israel)
people.summary: Wrestled with God and was renamed Israel; father of the twelve tribes; died in Egypt.
people.summaryZhHans: 与神较力,改名以色列;十二支派之祖;客死埃及。
people.summaryZhHant: 與神較力,改名以色列;十二支派之祖;客死埃及。

people.name: Leah
people.summary: Jacob's first wife; mother of Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun, and Dinah.
people.summaryZhHans: 雅各的元配;吕便、西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦、西布伦、底拿之母。
people.summaryZhHant: 雅各的元配;呂便、西緬、利未、猶大、以薩迦、西布倫、底拿之母。

people.name: Rachel
people.summary: Jacob's beloved wife; mother of Joseph and Benjamin; died at Benjamin's birth.
people.summaryZhHans: 雅各所爱之妻;约瑟与便雅悯之母;生便雅悯时去世。
people.summaryZhHant: 雅各所愛之妻;約瑟與便雅憫之母;生便雅憫時去世。

people.name: Bilhah
people.summary: Rachel's maidservant; mother of Dan and Naphtali.
people.summaryZhHans: 拉结的使女;但与拿弗他利之母。
people.summaryZhHant: 拉結的使女;但與拿弗他利之母。

people.name: Zilpah
people.summary: Leah's maidservant; mother of Gad and Asher.
people.summaryZhHans: 利亚的使女;迦得与亚设之母。
people.summaryZhHant: 利亞的使女;迦得與亞設之母。

people.name: Reuben
people.summary: Firstborn of Jacob; lost his preeminence through sin with Bilhah.
people.summaryZhHans: 雅各的长子;因与辟拉相犯失去长子尊荣。
people.summaryZhHant: 雅各的長子;因與辟拉相犯失去長子尊榮。

people.name: Simeon
people.summary: Second son of Jacob; with Levi avenged Dinah at Shechem.
people.summaryZhHans: 雅各的次子;偕利未在示剑为底拿报仇。
people.summaryZhHant: 雅各的次子;偕利未在示劍為底拿報仇。

people.name: Levi
people.summary: Third son of Jacob; ancestor of the priestly tribe — Moses, Aaron, and the Levites.
people.summaryZhHans: 雅各的第三子;祭司支派之祖——摩西、亚伦及利未人由此出。
people.summaryZhHant: 雅各的第三子;祭司支派之祖——摩西、亞倫及利未人由此出。

people.name: Judah
people.summary: Fourth son of Jacob; received the kingly blessing — 'the scepter shall not depart from Judah'. Ancestor of David and of Christ.
people.summaryZhHans: 雅各的第四子;领受王者之福——'圭必不离犹大'。大卫与基督由此出。
people.summaryZhHant: 雅各的第四子;領受王者之福——「圭必不離猶大」。大衛與基督由此出。

people.name: Dan
people.summary: Son of Bilhah; tribal patriarch.
people.summaryZhHans: 辟拉所生;十二支派之一的族长。
people.summaryZhHant: 辟拉所生;十二支派之一的族長。

people.name: Naphtali
people.summary: Son of Bilhah; tribal patriarch.
people.summaryZhHans: 辟拉所生;十二支派之一的族长。
people.summaryZhHant: 辟拉所生;十二支派之一的族長。

people.name: Gad
people.summary: Son of Zilpah; tribal patriarch.
people.summaryZhHans: 悉帕所生;十二支派之一的族长。
people.summaryZhHant: 悉帕所生;十二支派之一的族長。

people.name: Asher
people.summary: Son of Zilpah; tribal patriarch.
people.summaryZhHans: 悉帕所生;十二支派之一的族长。
people.summaryZhHant: 悉帕所生;十二支派之一的族長。

people.name: Issachar
people.summary: Fifth son of Leah; tribal patriarch.
people.summaryZhHans: 利亚的第五子;十二支派之一的族长。
people.summaryZhHant: 利亞的第五子;十二支派之一的族長。

people.name: Zebulun
people.summary: Sixth son of Leah; tribal patriarch; territory along the sea.
people.summaryZhHans: 利亚的第六子;十二支派之一的族长;地业临海。
people.summaryZhHant: 利亞的第六子;十二支派之一的族長;地業臨海。

people.name: Joseph
people.summary: Sold into Egypt by his brothers; rose to be vizier; preserved his family in famine. Type of Christ.
people.summaryZhHans: 被弟兄卖到埃及;升为宰相;饥荒中保全家族。基督之预表。
people.summaryZhHant: 被弟兄賣到埃及;升為宰相;饑荒中保全家族。基督之預表。

people.name: Manasseh
people.summary: Joseph's elder son; tribal patriarch (one of the half-tribes of Joseph).
people.summaryZhHans: 约瑟的长子;约瑟两半支派之一的族长。
people.summaryZhHant: 約瑟的長子;約瑟兩半支派之一的族長。

people.name: Ephraim
people.summary: Joseph's younger son; received the firstborn's blessing from Jacob; tribal patriarch.
people.summaryZhHans: 约瑟的次子;雅各按手赐其长子之福;支派族长。
people.summaryZhHant: 約瑟的次子;雅各按手賜其長子之福;支派族長。

people.name: Benjamin
people.summary: Youngest son of Jacob; Rachel died at his birth; tribe of Saul and the apostle Paul.
people.summaryZhHans: 雅各的小儿子;拉结生他时去世;扫罗与使徒保罗皆出此支派。
people.summaryZhHant: 雅各的小兒子;拉結生他時去世;掃羅與使徒保羅皆出此支派。

people.name: Dinah
people.summary: Jacob's only named daughter; defiled at Shechem, avenged by Simeon and Levi.
people.summaryZhHans: 雅各唯一被提名之女;在示剑受辱,西缅与利未为之报仇。
people.summaryZhHant: 雅各唯一被提名之女;在示劍受辱,西緬與利未為之報仇。

people.name: Perez
people.summary: Son of Judah by Tamar; ancestor of David and Christ.
people.summaryZhHans: 犹大与他玛之子;大卫与基督的先祖。
people.summaryZhHant: 猶大與他瑪之子;大衛與基督的先祖。

people.name: Hezron
people.summary: Son of Perez; in the line from Judah to David.
people.summaryZhHans: 法勒斯之子;由犹大至大卫的谱系。
people.summaryZhHant: 法勒斯之子;由猶大至大衛的譜系。

people.name: Ram
people.summary: Father of Amminadab; in the Davidic line.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚米拿达之父;大卫谱系。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞米拿達之父;大衛譜系。

people.name: Amminadab
people.summary: Father of Nahshon, the prince of Judah at the Exodus.
people.summaryZhHans: 拿顺之父;拿顺为出埃及时犹大支派之首领。
people.summaryZhHant: 拿順之父;拿順為出埃及時猶大支派之首領。

people.name: Nahshon
people.summary: Prince of the tribe of Judah at the Exodus; brother-in-law of Aaron through his sister Elisheba.
people.summaryZhHans: 出埃及时犹大支派的首领;其妹以利沙巴为亚伦之妻。
people.summaryZhHant: 出埃及時猶大支派的首領;其妹以利沙巴為亞倫之妻。

people.name: Salmon
people.summary: Husband of Rahab the Canaanite; father of Boaz; settlement-era patriarch.
people.summaryZhHans: 迦南女子喇合之夫;波阿斯之父;入迦南时代的先祖。
people.summaryZhHant: 迦南女子喇合之夫;波阿斯之父;入迦南時代的先祖。

people.name: Rahab
people.summary: The Canaanite of Jericho who hid Israel's spies; counted in Christ's genealogy.
people.summaryZhHans: 耶利哥的迦南女子,藏匿以色列探子;列于基督的家谱中。
people.summaryZhHant: 耶利哥的迦南女子,藏匿以色列探子;列於基督的家譜中。

people.name: Boaz
people.summary: Wealthy kinsman-redeemer who married Ruth; great-grandfather of David.
people.summaryZhHans: 至亲救赎者,娶路得为妻;大卫的曾祖父。
people.summaryZhHant: 至親救贖者,娶路得為妻;大衛的曾祖父。

people.name: Ruth
people.summary: Moabitess who left her people for Naomi's God; married Boaz; great-grandmother of David.
people.summaryZhHans: 摩押女子,撇下本族归向拿俄米的神;嫁波阿斯;大卫的曾祖母。
people.summaryZhHant: 摩押女子,撇下本族歸向拿俄米的神;嫁波阿斯;大衛的曾祖母。

people.name: Obed
people.summary: Son of Boaz and Ruth; grandfather of David.
people.summaryZhHans: 波阿斯与路得之子;大卫的祖父。
people.summaryZhHant: 波阿斯與路得之子;大衛的祖父。

people.name: Jesse
people.summary: Father of David; the 'stem of Jesse' from which Messiah springs.
people.summaryZhHans: 大卫之父;弥赛亚由'耶西的根'而出。
people.summaryZhHant: 大衛之父;彌賽亞由「耶西的根」而出。

people.name: David
people.summary: Shepherd, psalmist, king of Israel; received the Davidic covenant promising an eternal throne.
people.summaryZhHans: 牧人、诗人、以色列王;受大卫之约,应许永远的王位。
people.summaryZhHant: 牧人、詩人、以色列王;受大衛之約,應許永遠的王位。

people.name: Bathsheba
people.summary: Wife of Uriah, taken by David; later mother of Solomon and queen mother of his court.
people.summaryZhHans: 原为乌利亚之妻,大卫所夺;后为所罗门之母与太后。
people.summaryZhHant: 原為烏利亞之妻,大衛所奪;後為所羅門之母與太后。

people.name: Solomon
people.summary: Wisest king of Israel; built the first Temple; reigned at the height of the kingdom.
people.summaryZhHans: 以色列最有智慧的王;建造第一圣殿;国势鼎盛之时在位。
people.summaryZhHant: 以色列最有智慧的王;建造第一聖殿;國勢鼎盛之時在位。

people.name: Rehoboam
people.summary: Solomon's son; harsh reply to the elders precipitated the kingdom's split into Judah and Israel.
people.summaryZhHans: 所罗门之子;以暴言答覆长老,致王国分裂为犹大与以色列。
people.summaryZhHant: 所羅門之子;以暴言答覆長老,致王國分裂為猶大與以色列。

people.name: Hezekiah
people.summary: Reforming king of Judah; trusted the LORD against Sennacherib; granted 15 added years of life.
people.summaryZhHans: 犹大改革之王;倚靠耶和华抵挡西拿基立;蒙赐多活十五年。
people.summaryZhHant: 猶大改革之王;倚靠耶和華抵擋西拿基立;蒙賜多活十五年。

people.name: Josiah
people.summary: Last godly king of Judah; recovered the Book of the Law and led a great covenant renewal.
people.summaryZhHans: 犹大末代敬虔之王;寻见律法书,带领国民立约更新。
people.summaryZhHant: 猶大末代敬虔之王;尋見律法書,帶領國民立約更新。

people.name: Jeconiah (Jehoiachin)
people.summary: King of Judah deported to Babylon; final king before the exile in the southern kingdom's main line.
people.summaryZhHans: 被掳到巴比伦的犹大王;南国主脉中被掳前的末代君王。
people.summaryZhHant: 被擄到巴比倫的猶大王;南國主脈中被擄前的末代君王。

people.name: Shealtiel
people.summary: Son of Jeconiah in exile; in the line from David to Joseph (Matthew 1).
people.summaryZhHans: 被掳期间耶哥尼雅之子;由大卫至约瑟谱系(马太福音第一章)。
people.summaryZhHant: 被擄期間耶哥尼雅之子;由大衛至約瑟譜系(馬太福音第一章)。

people.name: Zerubbabel
people.summary: Governor of post-exilic Judah who led the rebuilding of the Second Temple.
people.summaryZhHans: 归回时期的犹大省长,领导第二圣殿之重建。
people.summaryZhHant: 歸回時期的猶大省長,領導第二聖殿之重建。

people.name: Joseph (husband of Mary)
people.summary: Carpenter of Nazareth; husband of Mary; legal father of Jesus, securing his Davidic descent.
people.summaryZhHans: 拿撒勒木匠;马利亚之夫;耶稣的法定父亲,使其承袭大卫王统。
people.summaryZhHant: 拿撒勒木匠;馬利亞之夫;耶穌的法定父親,使其承襲大衛王統。

people.name: Mary
people.summary: Virgin mother of Jesus; chosen of God to bear the Messiah.
people.summaryZhHans: 童贞女,生主耶稣;蒙神拣选,孕育弥赛亚。
people.summaryZhHant: 童貞女,生主耶穌;蒙神揀選,孕育彌賽亞。

people.name: Jesus
people.summary: The Christ; eternal Son of God, born of Mary; crucified, raised, ascended; fulfillment of every preceding promise.
people.summaryZhHans: 基督;神永恒的儿子,由马利亚所生;被钉、复活、升天——所有前应许的成就。
people.summaryZhHant: 基督;神永恆的兒子,由馬利亞所生;被釘、復活、升天——所有前應許的成就。

people.name: Haran
people.summary: Son of Terah; brother of Abraham; father of Lot, Milcah, and (per Genesis 11) Iscah. Died in Ur of the Chaldeans before the family migrated.
people.summaryZhHans: 他拉之子；亚伯拉罕的兄弟；罗得、密迦和以斯迦的父亲。在迦勒底的吾珥死去，全家因此迁徙。
people.summaryZhHant: 他拉之子；亞伯拉罕的兄弟；羅得、密迦和以斯迦的父親。在迦勒底的吾珥死去，全家因此遷徙。

people.name: Nahor
people.summary: Son of Terah; brother of Abraham. Married Milcah (daughter of his brother Haran). Grandfather of Rebekah through Bethuel.
people.summaryZhHans: 他拉之子；亚伯拉罕的兄弟。娶了他兄弟哈兰的女儿密迦为妻。利百加的祖父（透过彼土利）。
people.summaryZhHant: 他拉之子；亞伯拉罕的兄弟。娶了他兄弟哈蘭的女兒密迦為妻。利百加的祖父（透過彼土利）。

people.name: Lot
people.summary: Abraham's nephew; son of Haran. Travelled from Ur with Abraham, settled in Sodom, was rescued by angels before its destruction. Father of Moab and Ben-Ammi (Moabites and Ammonites).
people.summaryZhHans: 亚伯拉罕的侄子；哈兰之子。从吾珥与亚伯拉罕同行，定居所多玛，在城被毁前被天使救出。摩押和便亚米的父亲（摩押人和亚扪人的祖先）。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞伯拉罕的姪子；哈蘭之子。從吾珥與亞伯拉罕同行，定居所多瑪，在城被毀前被天使救出。摩押和便亞米的父親（摩押人和亞捫人的祖先）。

people.name: Milcah
people.summary: Daughter of Haran; married her uncle Nahor. Mother of Bethuel and grandmother of Rebekah and Laban.
people.summaryZhHans: 哈兰之女；嫁给她的叔叔拿鹤。彼土利的母亲，利百加和拉班的祖母。
people.summaryZhHant: 哈蘭之女；嫁給她的叔叔拿鶴。彼土利的母親，利百加和拉班的祖母。

people.name: Bethuel
people.summary: Son of Nahor and Milcah; father of Rebekah (who married Isaac) and Laban (Jacob's father-in-law).
people.summaryZhHans: 拿鹤与密迦之子；利百加（嫁给以撒）和拉班（雅各的岳父）的父亲。
people.summaryZhHant: 拿鶴與密迦之子；利百加（嫁給以撒）和拉班（雅各的岳父）的父親。

people.name: Laban
people.summary: Son of Bethuel; brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel. Jacob worked 14 years to marry his daughters and 6 more for flocks.
people.summaryZhHans: 彼土利之子；利百加的兄弟；利亚和拉结的父亲。雅各为娶他的女儿做工十四年，又为牲畜做工六年。
people.summaryZhHant: 彼土利之子；利百加的兄弟；利亞和拉結的父親。雅各為娶他的女兒做工十四年，又為牲畜做工六年。

people.name: Kohath
people.summary: Second son of Levi; ancestor of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam. The Kohathites carried the Ark in the wilderness.
people.summaryZhHans: 利未的次子；摩西、亚伦、米利暗的祖先。哥辖人在旷野中抬约柜。
people.summaryZhHant: 利未的次子；摩西、亞倫、米利暗的祖先。哥轄人在曠野中抬約櫃。

people.name: Amram
people.summary: Son of Kohath; husband of Jochebed; father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.
people.summaryZhHans: 哥辖之子；约基别的丈夫；亚伦、摩西、米利暗的父亲。
people.summaryZhHant: 哥轄之子；約基別的丈夫；亞倫、摩西、米利暗的父親。

people.name: Jochebed
people.summary: Daughter of Levi; wife of her nephew Amram; mother of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Hid Moses in the basket on the Nile.
people.summaryZhHans: 利未之女；她侄子暗兰的妻子；亚伦、摩西、米利暗的母亲。把摩西藏在尼罗河的篮中。
people.summaryZhHant: 利未之女；她姪子暗蘭的妻子；亞倫、摩西、米利暗的母親。把摩西藏在尼羅河的籃中。

people.name: Aaron
people.summary: Older brother of Moses; first High Priest of Israel; spokesman to Pharaoh. Founded the Aaronic priesthood that served until the New Covenant.
people.summaryZhHans: 摩西的哥哥；以色列的第一位大祭司；对法老的发言人。开创了亚伦的祭司体系，事奉直到新约。
people.summaryZhHant: 摩西的哥哥；以色列的第一位大祭司；對法老的發言人。開創了亞倫的祭司體系，事奉直到新約。

people.name: Moses
people.summary: Lawgiver of Israel; led the Exodus from Egypt; received the Ten Commandments at Sinai. Author of the Pentateuch (Genesis–Deuteronomy).
people.summaryZhHans: 以色列的律法颁布者；带领出埃及；在西奈山领受十诫。摩西五经（创世记—申命记）的作者。
people.summaryZhHant: 以色列的律法頒布者；帶領出埃及；在西奈山領受十誡。摩西五經（創世記—申命記）的作者。

people.name: Miriam
people.summary: Older sister of Moses and Aaron. Watched over the basket on the Nile; led the women in song after crossing the Red Sea; struck with leprosy for opposing Moses.
people.summaryZhHans: 摩西和亚伦的姐姐。在尼罗河边看守篮子；过红海后带领妇女歌唱；因反对摩西被罚患大麻风。
people.summaryZhHant: 摩西和亞倫的姐姐。在尼羅河邊看守籃子；過紅海後帶領婦女歌唱；因反對摩西被罰患大痲瘋。

people.name: Abiud
people.summary: Listed in the genealogy of Jesus per Matthew 1:13-16; descendant of David through Solomon.
people.summaryZhHans: 马太福音 1:13-16 所列耶稣家谱中的祖先；大卫透过所罗门的后裔。
people.summaryZhHant: 馬太福音 1:13-16 所列耶穌家譜中的祖先；大衛透過所羅門的後裔。

people.name: Eliakim
people.summary: Listed in the genealogy of Jesus per Matthew 1:13-16; descendant of David through Solomon.
people.summaryZhHans: 马太福音 1:13-16 所列耶稣家谱中的祖先；大卫透过所罗门的后裔。
people.summaryZhHant: 馬太福音 1:13-16 所列耶穌家譜中的祖先；大衛透過所羅門的後裔。

people.name: Azor
people.summary: Listed in the genealogy of Jesus per Matthew 1:13-16; descendant of David through Solomon.
people.summaryZhHans: 马太福音 1:13-16 所列耶稣家谱中的祖先；大卫透过所罗门的后裔。
people.summaryZhHant: 馬太福音 1:13-16 所列耶穌家譜中的祖先；大衛透過所羅門的後裔。

people.name: Zadok
people.summary: Listed in the genealogy of Jesus per Matthew 1:13-16; descendant of David through Solomon.
people.summaryZhHans: 马太福音 1:13-16 所列耶稣家谱中的祖先；大卫透过所罗门的后裔。
people.summaryZhHant: 馬太福音 1:13-16 所列耶穌家譜中的祖先；大衛透過所羅門的後裔。

people.name: Achim
people.summary: Listed in the genealogy of Jesus per Matthew 1:13-16; descendant of David through Solomon.
people.summaryZhHans: 马太福音 1:13-16 所列耶稣家谱中的祖先；大卫透过所罗门的后裔。
people.summaryZhHant: 馬太福音 1:13-16 所列耶穌家譜中的祖先；大衛透過所羅門的後裔。

people.name: Eliud
people.summary: Listed in the genealogy of Jesus per Matthew 1:13-16; descendant of David through Solomon.
people.summaryZhHans: 马太福音 1:13-16 所列耶稣家谱中的祖先；大卫透过所罗门的后裔。
people.summaryZhHant: 馬太福音 1:13-16 所列耶穌家譜中的祖先；大衛透過所羅門的後裔。

people.name: Eleazar
people.summary: Listed in the genealogy of Jesus per Matthew 1:13-16; descendant of David through Solomon.
people.summaryZhHans: 马太福音 1:13-16 所列耶稣家谱中的祖先；大卫透过所罗门的后裔。
people.summaryZhHant: 馬太福音 1:13-16 所列耶穌家譜中的祖先；大衛透過所羅門的後裔。

people.name: Matthan
people.summary: Listed in the genealogy of Jesus per Matthew 1:13-16; descendant of David through Solomon.
people.summaryZhHans: 马太福音 1:13-16 所列耶稣家谱中的祖先；大卫透过所罗门的后裔。
people.summaryZhHant: 馬太福音 1:13-16 所列耶穌家譜中的祖先；大衛透過所羅門的後裔。

people.name: Jacob
people.summary: Listed in the genealogy of Jesus per Matthew 1:13-16; descendant of David through Solomon.
people.summaryZhHans: 马太福音 1:13-16 所列耶稣家谱中的祖先；大卫透过所罗门的后裔。
people.summaryZhHant: 馬太福音 1:13-16 所列耶穌家譜中的祖先；大衛透過所羅門的後裔。

people.name: Abijah
people.summary: 3rd king of Judah; reigned 3 years; warred with Jeroboam of Israel.
people.summaryZhHans: 犹大第三位王；在位三年；与以色列王耶罗波安交战。
people.summaryZhHant: 猶大第三位王；在位三年；與以色列王耶羅波安交戰。

people.name: Asa
people.summary: Reforming king of Judah; tore down high places and removed idols; reigned 41 years.
people.summaryZhHans: 改革派的犹大王；拆毁丘坛，除掉偶像；在位四十一年。
people.summaryZhHant: 改革派的猶大王；拆毀丘壇，除掉偶像；在位四十一年。

people.name: Jehoshaphat
people.summary: Godly king of Judah; allied with Ahab; sent priests to teach the Law throughout Judah.
people.summaryZhHans: 敬虔的犹大王；与亚哈结盟；差祭司在犹大遍地教导律法。
people.summaryZhHant: 敬虔的猶大王；與亞哈結盟；差祭司在猶大遍地教導律法。

people.name: Jehoram
people.summary: King of Judah; married Athaliah daughter of Ahab; killed his brothers; died of disease per Elijah's prophecy.
people.summaryZhHans: 犹大王；娶亚哈之女亚他利雅；杀害众兄弟；按以利亚的预言因病而死。
people.summaryZhHant: 猶大王；娶亞哈之女亞他利雅；殺害眾兄弟；按以利亞的預言因病而死。

people.name: Ahaziah
people.summary: King of Judah; reigned one year; killed by Jehu along with Joram of Israel.
people.summaryZhHans: 犹大王；在位一年；与以色列王约兰一同被耶户所杀。
people.summaryZhHant: 猶大王；在位一年；與以色列王約蘭一同被耶戶所殺。

people.name: Joash
people.summary: Hidden as a child by his aunt Jehosheba; crowned king at age seven by Jehoiada the priest; restored the Temple.
people.summaryZhHans: 幼年由姑母约示巴所藏；七岁时由祭司耶何耶大立为王；重修圣殿。
people.summaryZhHant: 幼年由姑母約示巴所藏；七歲時由祭司耶何耶大立為王；重修聖殿。

people.name: Amaziah
people.summary: King of Judah; defeated Edom but later defeated by Joash of Israel; killed in conspiracy.
people.summaryZhHans: 犹大王；击败以东，却后来被以色列王约阿施所败；死于谋反。
people.summaryZhHant: 猶大王；擊敗以東，卻後來被以色列王約阿施所敗；死於謀反。

people.name: Uzziah
people.summary: Also called Azariah; powerful king who built towers and engines of war; struck with leprosy for offering incense in the Temple.
people.summaryZhHans: 又名亚撒利雅；建造塔楼和战争器械的大能王；因擅自在殿中烧香被罚长大麻风。
people.summaryZhHant: 又名亞撒利雅；建造塔樓和戰爭器械的大能王；因擅自在殿中燒香被罰長大痲瘋。

people.name: Jotham
people.summary: Co-regent during his father Uzziah’s leprosy; built the Upper Gate of the Temple; right in the eyes of the Lord.
people.summaryZhHans: 父亲乌西雅长大麻风期间共同摄政；建造圣殿的上门；行耶和华看为正的事。
people.summaryZhHant: 父親烏西雅長大痲瘋期間共同攝政；建造聖殿的上門；行耶和華看為正的事。

people.name: Ahaz
people.summary: Wicked king of Judah; sacrificed sons to Molech; brought Assyrian altar into the Temple; received the Immanuel sign from Isaiah.
people.summaryZhHans: 邪恶的犹大王；将儿子献给摩洛；将亚述祭坛搬入圣殿；以赛亚向他宣告以马内利的兆头。
people.summaryZhHant: 邪惡的猶大王；將兒子獻給摩洛；將亞述祭壇搬入聖殿；以賽亞向他宣告以馬內利的兆頭。

people.name: Manasseh
people.summary: Most wicked king of Judah; reigned 55 years; later humbled himself in Babylonian captivity and was restored.
people.summaryZhHans: 犹大最邪恶的王；在位五十五年；后在巴比伦被掳期间自卑悔改，得以回国。
people.summaryZhHant: 猶大最邪惡的王；在位五十五年；後在巴比倫被擄期間自卑悔改，得以回國。

people.name: Amon
people.summary: Wicked king of Judah; reigned 2 years; assassinated by his own servants.
people.summaryZhHans: 邪恶的犹大王；在位两年；被臣仆杀害。
people.summaryZhHant: 邪惡的猶大王；在位兩年；被臣僕殺害。

people.name: Jehoiakim
people.summary: Son of Josiah; placed on the throne by Pharaoh Necho; rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar; burned the scroll Jeremiah dictated.
people.summaryZhHans: 约西亚之子；被埃及法老尼哥立为王；背叛尼布甲尼撒；烧毁耶利米所述写的书卷。
people.summaryZhHant: 約西亞之子；被埃及法老尼哥立為王；背叛尼布甲尼撒；燒毀耶利米所述寫的書卷。

people.name: Nadab
people.summary: Aaron's eldest son; struck dead with his brother Abihu for offering 'strange fire' before the Lord.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚伦的长子；与兄弟亚比户因献凡火被耶和华击杀。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞倫的長子；與兄弟亞比戶因獻凡火被耶和華擊殺。

people.name: Abihu
people.summary: Second son of Aaron; struck dead with Nadab for offering 'strange fire'.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚伦的次子；与拿答因献凡火被击杀。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞倫的次子；與拿答因獻凡火被擊殺。

people.name: Eleazar
people.summary: Aaron's third son; succeeded him as High Priest; allotted the Promised Land with Joshua.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚伦的三子；继承父亲为大祭司；与约书亚一同分配应许之地。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞倫的三子；繼承父親為大祭司；與約書亞一同分配應許之地。

people.name: Ithamar
people.summary: Aaron's youngest son; oversaw the Levites in the wilderness; ancestor of Eli the priest.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚伦的幼子；在旷野管理利未人；祭司以利的祖先。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞倫的幼子；在曠野管理利未人；祭司以利的祖先。

people.name: Zipporah
people.summary: Daughter of Jethro the Midianite priest; wife of Moses; mother of Gershom and Eliezer.
people.summaryZhHans: 米甸祭司叶忒罗的女儿；摩西的妻子；革舜与以利以谢的母亲。
people.summaryZhHant: 米甸祭司葉忒羅的女兒；摩西的妻子；革舜與以利以謝的母親。

people.name: Gershom
people.summary: Eldest son of Moses; his name means 'sojourner there'.
people.summaryZhHans: 摩西的长子；名字意为「在那里寄居」。
people.summaryZhHant: 摩西的長子；名字意為「在那裡寄居」。

people.name: Eliezer
people.summary: Younger son of Moses; his name means 'My God is help'.
people.summaryZhHans: 摩西的次子；名字意为「我的神是帮助」。
people.summaryZhHant: 摩西的次子；名字意為「我的神是幫助」。

people.name: Enoch (Cain’s son)
people.summary: Son of Cain; the city Cain built was named after him.
people.summaryZhHans: 该隐之子；该隐所建的城以他为名。
people.summaryZhHant: 該隱之子；該隱所建的城以他為名。

people.name: Irad
people.summary: Son of Enoch (Cain’s line).
people.summaryZhHans: 以诺之子（该隐家系）。
people.summaryZhHant: 以諾之子（該隱家系）。

people.name: Mehujael
people.summary: Son of Irad in Cain’s line.
people.summaryZhHans: 以拿之子，属该隐家系。
people.summaryZhHant: 以拿之子，屬該隱家系。

people.name: Methushael
people.summary: Son of Mehujael in Cain’s line.
people.summaryZhHans: 米户雅利之子，属该隐家系。
people.summaryZhHant: 米戶雅利之子，屬該隱家系。

people.name: Lamech (of Cain)
people.summary: Sixth generation in Cain’s line; took two wives Adah and Zillah; sang the first recorded song of vengeance.
people.summaryZhHans: 该隐家系的第六代；娶亚大与洗拉为妻；唱出经文记载的最早一首报复之歌。
people.summaryZhHant: 該隱家系的第六代；娶亞大與洗拉為妻；唱出經文記載的最早一首報復之歌。

people.name: Adah
people.summary: Wife of Lamech in Cain’s line; mother of Jabal and Jubal.
people.summaryZhHans: 该隐家系拉麦之妻；雅八与犹八之母。
people.summaryZhHant: 該隱家系拉麥之妻；雅八與猶八之母。

people.name: Zillah
people.summary: Wife of Lamech in Cain’s line; mother of Tubal-cain and Naamah.
people.summaryZhHans: 该隐家系拉麦之妻；土八该隐与拿玛之母。
people.summaryZhHant: 該隱家系拉麥之妻；土八該隱與拿瑪之母。

people.name: Jabal
people.summary: Father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.
people.summaryZhHans: 住帐篷牧养牲畜之人的祖师。
people.summaryZhHant: 住帳篷牧養牲畜之人的祖師。

people.name: Jubal
people.summary: Father of all who play the lyre and pipe.
people.summaryZhHans: 一切弹琴吹箫之人的祖师。
people.summaryZhHant: 一切彈琴吹簫之人的祖師。

people.name: Tubal-cain
people.summary: Forger of all instruments of bronze and iron.
people.summaryZhHans: 打造各样铜铁利器之人的祖师。
people.summaryZhHant: 打造各樣銅鐵利器之人的祖師。

people.name: Naamah
people.summary: Sister of Tubal-cain.
people.summaryZhHans: 土八该隐的妹妹。
people.summaryZhHant: 土八該隱的妹妹。

people.name: Nebaioth
people.summary: Ishmael's firstborn; chief of an Arab tribe.
people.summaryZhHans: 以实玛利长子；阿拉伯部族的族长。
people.summaryZhHant: 以實瑪利長子；阿拉伯部族的族長。

people.name: Kedar
people.summary: Second son of Ishmael; the Kedarites became a major Arab tribe in Scripture.
people.summaryZhHans: 以实玛利次子；基达人是经文中重要的阿拉伯部族。
people.summaryZhHant: 以實瑪利次子；基達人是經文中重要的阿拉伯部族。

people.name: Adbeel
people.summary: Son of Ishmael.
people.summaryZhHans: 以实玛利之子。
people.summaryZhHant: 以實瑪利之子。

people.name: Mibsam
people.summary: Son of Ishmael.
people.summaryZhHans: 以实玛利之子。
people.summaryZhHant: 以實瑪利之子。

people.name: Mishma
people.summary: Son of Ishmael.
people.summaryZhHans: 以实玛利之子。
people.summaryZhHant: 以實瑪利之子。

people.name: Dumah
people.summary: Son of Ishmael; an oasis tribe.
people.summaryZhHans: 以实玛利之子；绿洲部族。
people.summaryZhHant: 以實瑪利之子；綠洲部族。

people.name: Massa
people.summary: Son of Ishmael.
people.summaryZhHans: 以实玛利之子。
people.summaryZhHant: 以實瑪利之子。

people.name: Hadad
people.summary: Son of Ishmael.
people.summaryZhHans: 以实玛利之子。
people.summaryZhHant: 以實瑪利之子。

people.name: Tema
people.summary: Son of Ishmael; namesake of the oasis Tema.
people.summaryZhHans: 以实玛利之子；提玛绿洲以他为名。
people.summaryZhHant: 以實瑪利之子；提瑪綠洲以他為名。

people.name: Jetur
people.summary: Son of Ishmael.
people.summaryZhHans: 以实玛利之子。
people.summaryZhHant: 以實瑪利之子。

people.name: Naphish
people.summary: Son of Ishmael.
people.summaryZhHans: 以实玛利之子。
people.summaryZhHant: 以實瑪利之子。

people.name: Kedemah
people.summary: Son of Ishmael.
people.summaryZhHans: 以实玛利之子。
people.summaryZhHant: 以實瑪利之子。

people.name: Moab
people.summary: Born of Lot and his elder daughter after Sodom's destruction; ancestor of the Moabites.
people.summaryZhHans: 所多玛被毁后，由罗得与长女所生；摩押人的祖先。
people.summaryZhHant: 所多瑪被毀後，由羅得與長女所生；摩押人的祖先。

people.name: Ben-Ammi
people.summary: Born of Lot and his younger daughter; ancestor of the Ammonites.
people.summaryZhHans: 罗得与小女所生；亚扪人的祖先。
people.summaryZhHant: 羅得與小女所生；亞捫人的祖先。

people.name: Zimran
people.summary: Son of Abraham by Keturah; ancestor of an Arabian tribal people.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚伯拉罕与基土拉所生之子；阿拉伯部族的祖先。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞伯拉罕與基土拉所生之子；阿拉伯部族的祖先。

people.name: Jokshan
people.summary: Son of Abraham by Keturah; ancestor of an Arabian tribal people.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚伯拉罕与基土拉所生之子；阿拉伯部族的祖先。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞伯拉罕與基土拉所生之子；阿拉伯部族的祖先。

people.name: Medan
people.summary: Son of Abraham by Keturah; ancestor of an Arabian tribal people.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚伯拉罕与基土拉所生之子；阿拉伯部族的祖先。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞伯拉罕與基土拉所生之子；阿拉伯部族的祖先。

people.name: Ishbak
people.summary: Son of Abraham by Keturah; ancestor of an Arabian tribal people.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚伯拉罕与基土拉所生之子；阿拉伯部族的祖先。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞伯拉罕與基土拉所生之子；阿拉伯部族的祖先。

people.name: Shuah
people.summary: Son of Abraham by Keturah; ancestor of an Arabian tribal people.
people.summaryZhHans: 亚伯拉罕与基土拉所生之子；阿拉伯部族的祖先。
people.summaryZhHant: 亞伯拉罕與基土拉所生之子；阿拉伯部族的祖先。

people.name: Gershon
people.summary: Eldest son of Levi; founded the Gershonite clan of priests, who carried the Tabernacle's curtains.
people.summaryZhHans: 利未的长子；革顺族的祖先，会幕的幔子由他们抬运。
people.summaryZhHant: 利未的長子；革順族的祖先，會幕的幔子由他們抬運。

people.name: Merari
people.summary: Youngest son of Levi; founded the Merarite clan, who carried the Tabernacle's frames and bars.
people.summaryZhHans: 利未的幼子；米拉利族的祖先，会幕的板和闩由他们抬运。
people.summaryZhHant: 利未的幼子；米拉利族的祖先，會幕的板和閂由他們抬運。

people.name: Eliphaz
people.summary: Esau's firstborn; ancestor of several Edomite chiefs; father of Amalek by Timna.
people.summaryZhHans: 以扫的长子；以东多个族长的祖先；与亭纳生亚玛力。
people.summaryZhHant: 以掃的長子；以東多個族長的祖先；與亭納生亞瑪力。

people.name: Reuel
people.summary: Son of Esau; chief of an Edomite clan.
people.summaryZhHans: 以扫之子；以东族长之一。
people.summaryZhHant: 以掃之子；以東族長之一。

people.name: Amalek
people.summary: Son of Eliphaz by his concubine Timna; ancestor of the Amalekites, perpetual enemies of Israel.
people.summaryZhHans: 以利法与妾亭纳所生；亚玛力人的祖先，以色列世代的敌人。
people.summaryZhHant: 以利法與妾亭納所生；亞瑪力人的祖先，以色列世代的敵人。
